# Smart Tourism Engineering Showcase Project

[English](https://github.com/888newstep/travel-website/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) | 中文

A full-stack project aimed at **campus recruitment defense and technical exchange with companies and schools**. It focuses on demonstrating Spring Boot microservices, JWT authentication, HTTP idempotency, concurrency consistency, real Amap (Gaode) traffic data, reliable RabbitMQ notifications, and reproducible JMeter load testing. Enterprise-grade infrastructure covers end-to-end traceId, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, gateway rate limiting, graceful shutdown, and one-click CD via a self-hosted runner. It is not a commercially operated tourism platform, so the documentation clearly distinguishes between verified capabilities, capabilities dependent on external conditions, and unimplemented capabilities.

> **Scope constraints**: Milvus is not used; no SMS billing, balance, or invoicing is added; traffic data only accepts results from the project-configured Amap API; RabbitMQ uses a cloud instance, while MySQL, Redis, and JMeter run locally on Win11.

## Current Acceptance Snapshot

|------|------|
| Backend full test suite | 320 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped |
| Route favorite same-key idempotency | 100 concurrent requests: only 1 business execution, 99 returned HTTP 409 (in progress), final 1 record |

| Real Amap outbound calls | Two-point driving returned 161 real-time traffic segments; three-point waypoint planning returned 55 navigation steps |
| Cloud RabbitMQ | Real publish/consume, duplicate idempotency, retry/DLQ, replay, restart, disconnect recovery, and 100-message concurrency all passed |

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web plugin: merges the **per-session token cost estimate** and the **DeepSeek API balance** into the **built-in stats bar** below the input box.

Liangpige/Lyricard.body:
# Lyricard · 浮声

**A lyrics card floating on your desktop.** By default it only watches Apple Music, but it also works with 10 other players, including NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, and Spotify, and displays whichever one is playing.

A small tool that lives in the Windows system tray. By default it only watches **Apple Music (Windows version)**, but you can also tick **NetEase Cloud Music / QQ Music / Spotify / KuGou** and 9 players in total on the main page. Whichever one is playing gets shown. The desktop corner displays the song title, artist, single-line synced lyrics, a progress bar, previous / pause / next buttons, and a circular album cover.

Layout: the song title and artist are on the same line (the artist follows the title in a smaller, lighter font). If the title is too long, it is automatically truncated with an ellipsis and **keeps a two-character margin on the left**, so it doesn't touch the leftmost edge. **The artist name is limited to 15 characters by default** (adjustable in settings from 4 to 40). Anything longer is cut to 'first N-1 characters + …', so it never squeezes out the song title. Text, progress bar, and buttons are **all right-aligned** to the same right edge. The height of the whole content block does not exceed the album cover on the right, and the card as a whole is 470×120.

**No background by default**: only the text and cover float on the desktop, and mouse clicks on empty areas pass straight through to the desktop. **Only the cover has a shadow across the whole interface** (the text, buttons, and progress bar have none). If you switch to a light wallpaper and the white text is hard to read, turn on 'Text shadow (for light wallpapers)' in the 'Card' group on the 'Appearance' page, or change the text color to a dark one. To get a card with a background, turn off 'Transparent background' on the 'Appearance' page or in the tray menu.

Zero installation, zero administrator privileges, and no external runtime dependencies (it only uses the built-in .NET Framework 4.x + WPF).

> **Some players must first enable SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) in their own settings before Lyricard can see them.**
> Apple Music, Spotify, and Windows Media Player are enabled by default. Clients such as **NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, and KuGou** require you to go to 'Settings → System/General' and turn on a switch such as 'System media controls', 'SMTC', or 'taskbar lyrics'. Otherwise, ticking the player on the Lyricard main page will have no effect. It isn't that the player isn't playing; the system simply doesn't receive its session. Kuwo Music has no such switch at all, so it has been removed from the list.

Moodzzzz/shenzhou-hitch-monitor.body:
# 神州车价 · 顺风车监控 + 长租行情

Monitors two types of cars in the Shenzhou Car Rental (神州租车) app:

1. **Hitch cars (顺风车)**: special-offer cross-city repositioning cars. The car needs to be driven from one city back to another. You take it at a fixed price of 1 / 50 / 100 CNY and drive it there, with a rental period of 1 to 13 days. These are usually grabbed quickly, so a program is needed to monitor them.
2. **Weekly / half-month / monthly rentals**: data is fetched separately for 7 / 15 / 30-day terms. Daily averages from the list are only candidate references. The price calendar is checked separately with day-by-day totals. Fees are not fabricated until the order's payable fee breakdown is obtained.

What the program does: **periodically fetches the full dataset → compares lifecycle (newly listed / locked / returned to order pool / expired and removed) → filters by conditions → sends email and other notifications**, and syncs the results to a searchable **visual dashboard**.

> The reverse-engineering process and API evidence chain are in [`docs/REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md`](https://github.com/Moodzzzz/shenzhou-hitch-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md).
> Live dashboard: <https://moodzzzz.github.io/shenzhou-hitch-monitor/>

---

## What it tells you

| Event | Meaning | Pushed by default |
|---|---|---|
| 🆕 **New listing** | Newly released hitch car | Yes |
| ♻️ **Back to order pool** | A previously locked or closed car is bookable again after its order was cancelled | Yes |
| 🔒 **Locked** | The car was locked by another booking and has disappeared from the bookable pool | Yes |
| ⬇️ **Price drop** | The price of the same `hitchId` was lowered | Yes |
| ⌛ **Removed as expired** | The return date has passed, so it is removed from the database | No (count only) |
| 🧹 **Removed as closed** | The work order no longer exists | No (count only) |

> "Locked" is not a guess. The list API only returns bookable cars, so when a car disappears, the program **re-checks that specific route**. Only if it still cannot be found is it judged unbookable. It also requires **two consecutive rounds** of not finding the car before sending a notification, to avoid false alarms caused by pagination jitter.

---

WLChara/RAReplayPlugin.body:
# RAReplayPlugin

Replay recording and playback plugin for Red Alert 2: Yuri's Revenge.

The plugin is loaded into the game via Syringe. During a match, it records player commands. During playback, it replays the entire match frame by frame inside the game and overlays a viewing interface on the screen. Replay files use the `.yrrep` extension. This repository contains the plugin source code, offline tests, debugging tools, and a C# class library for launcher integration. It does not include game files, a complete client, or prebuilt binaries.

## Features

**Recording**

- Supports skirmish and multiplayer matches.
- Records player commands, as well as local input side effects that affect simulation results (for example, the hint animation for move commands). Single-player matches also record game speed changes made mid-match.
- Replays are written to disk as they are recorded. Incomplete replays left by abnormal exits can still be played back to the last complete frame.
- Replays are compressed in blocks, and each block has a checksum. Completed replays also have an overall hash.

**Playback**

- Replays the original frames inside the game. Multiplayer replays compare sync checksums frame by frame and stop immediately when a mismatch is found.
- During playback, viewers' unit commands are blocked. This does not affect the replay itself.

**Viewing interface**

- Pause, resume, restart, and exit playback.
- Seven viewing speeds (skirmish replays).
- A progress bar shows game time. Clicking or dragging to any point after the current position fast-forwards the game to that time. Fast-forwarding can be cancelled.
- Side panel: overview, production (including production-halt records), units, control groups, and economy (funds curve, expandable to a large window).
- Radar event alerts for superweapon launches and buildings being infiltrated. Superweapon impact points are marked on the map.
- Map zoom from 1/3× to 4×, adjustable with Ctrl + mouse wheel or interface buttons.
- A semi-transparent black curtain that only changes rendering. It does not change map reveal or simulation.
- Press F10 to hide or show the interface.

## Requirements

- Only the following `gamemd.exe` is supported:

  ```text
  SHA-256 7cd005d263fde203d9c84548200a057a8df61d724da3c6bd1e521eeb61cd0747
  ImageBase 0x400000
  ```

- The viewing interface is drawn with Direct3D 9 or OpenGL. The interface is not shown when GDI software rendering is used.
- Recording and playback are both initiated by the launcher. The launcher generates recording or playback requests, validates maps, and restores match setup. The plugin handles recording, replaying, and the viewing interface. The `RAReplay.Client` class library in `integrations/csharp` implements the file format and request protocol on the launcher side. It can be referenced by launchers based on .NET Framework 4.8.

## Build and Test

Requires Windows, Visual Studio 2022 (with C++ desktop development and .NET Framework 4.8 development tools), the Windows SDK, CMake, and PowerShell. The plugin is built for Win32/x86.

WWFZS/dsh-ui-stage.body:
# Startup Animation

Startup screen, interface themes, and desktop pet. One plugin covers all three.

[Install](#安装) · [Interface Preview](#界面预览) · [Startup Animation](#怎么用) · [Interface Themes & Wallpapers](#界面主题壁纸) · [Desktop Pet](#桌面宠物) · [Compatibility](#对未来-dsh-版本的兼容性) · [Changelog](https://github.com/WWFZS/dsh-ui-stage/releases) · [Build from Source](#开发)

---

## Project Overview

**Startup Animation (Startup Animation)** is an appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness, bundling **startup screen + interface themes + desktop pet**. One plugin handles all three, so you don't need to install three separate plugins.

- **Startup screen**: On launch, it overlays an animation on top of the loading page and **listens for the moment the app is actually ready**. As soon as the interface takes over, the animation fades out. What you wait for is always the app itself, not the animation.
- **Interface themes**: The same video or image can also be spread behind the app interface as a background. Five built-in presets change the look with one click. The mask, blur, and color intensity are each adjustable, and they ship **at maximum transparency**. Text color is derived from the wallpaper's measured contrast, so it stays readable even on dark wallpapers.
- **Desktop pet**: A transparent little animal floats over the interface and cycles through its actions on its own. You can drag it around, and when you flick it, it carries momentum and bounces back off the edges. Each pet remembers its own size and position, and you can keep two at once. **It can also live globally**: switch to "Global Interface" and it floats above the browser, the desktop, and all other windows (Windows only, requires a local Electron install).

The plugin connects to the core through two extension points: `webserver/index-inject` injects the overlay and styles, and `webServer.register` provides assets and management routes. **It has no npm package dependencies at runtime.** The browser side only pulls from the host's module table via `require('react')`, so it works right after installation with no build step.

# DiPlay API 17 Compatibility Port

This repository is a wired and wireless CarPlay port for Android API 17, based on [shihabal3amri/DiPlay](https://github.com/shihabal3amri/DiPlay). The project code follows GPL-3.0. Public source code and release APKs are published on GitHub Releases.

## Automatic connection at boot, no VPN authorization needed

**This project handles the communication CarPlay requires inside the app. Neither the wired nor the wireless version needs to establish an Android system VPN, and no VPN authorization dialog appears after the head unit restarts.**

- **Wired: connects on plug-in.** The in-app lwIP network stack handles IPv6, TCP, and UDP directly over the USB NCM link, and projection sessions use in-app sockets. After enabling auto-connect and completing the first-time authorization, the head unit detects the iPhone at boot, and plugging in the data cable starts projection automatically.
- **Wireless: connects automatically in the car.** The in-app USB Bluetooth stack handles pairing with the external adapter and uses iAP2 to guide the iPhone to join the Wi-Fi Direct LAN created by the head unit. Video, audio, and control go directly over Wi-Fi. After the first pairing and successful projection, keep the adapter plugged in and the iPhone's Bluetooth and Wi-Fi turned on, and the head unit will automatically attempt to connect at boot.

On first use, follow the system prompts to complete the USB access authorization and confirm on the iPhone. The wireless version uses this mode by default on MX9A0 head units that support Wi-Fi Direct. Please turn off the head unit's system hotspot; the head unit's mobile data can stay on.

This project is an unofficial, non-profit fan game made by enthusiasts, and it has no connection with the rights holders of the original work.

## The Two Episodes' Routes

Episode 1, "Apprentice Witch Elaina": from her hometown to the forest cabin to become an apprentice. While doing chores for Flan, she teaches you to carry firewood with a thread of golden line. Afterward you practice wind magic in the clearing, then take Flan's trial. This duel also serves as combat tutorial: lock-on, dodge, block, counterattack, and answering the opponent with counter-elements are all learned one by one during the duel. Then come naming, the brooch, and parting from her mother.

Episode 2, "The Land of Mages": cross Star Trace Lake to the west, pass through the plains, climb the high pass, and fly into the city through the arch of the south gate. Run into Saya on the rooftops, repair roof tiles, find the inn, then practice with her flying through three rings. After saying goodbye at the city gate come the epilogue and end credits. After clearing the game, the map remains freely flyable, and you can return to the forest clearing to find Flan and duel again. This bout adds a harder fourth phase.

Flan's meteorite, the lake it carved out, and the solar eclipse during the western crossing of the lake are new plot additions for this adaptation.

## What You Can Do

### Dueling: learning combat through combat

Enemies have visible wind-up motions before they attack, and once they strike they follow through, unless staggered, shocked, or frozen. Time your dodge or block well and the foe opens up for a counterattack. Alternating different elements can break its stance, and when its health runs low it fights desperately and attacks faster. The eastern grassland has few monsters. The western wilderness and high pass have camps, five named elites, and foes who ambush from the air on brooms. Wasteland wolves, mud blobs, pass stone guards, ember serpents, frost-horn deer, and bandit mages each have their own approach, and those with elemental shields are only vulnerable to their counter-element. Elites, trial guardians, and Flan's replay duel are all multi-phase, and even skilled players will spend several minutes on them.

The combat tutorial is Flan's first duel. Dodging, parrying, charging, and second-stage combos are learned in the Torn Page trial you first reach. Sprinting, the broom, eating bread, the magic wheel, and the map: Elaina's travel notes write a short reminder the first time you need each one, and once you've followed it, that item is crossed off.

## ✨ Why Woo

Woo (无我笔记, "No-Self Notes") is a local-first Markdown note-taking app. You can write offline on your device without an account. When you need to sync across devices, configure the same WebDAV account on each device, then join the same end-to-end encrypted space using a six-digit pairing code.

> **v0.8.2**: Fixes the Android "project homepage" not opening links, and fixes a bug where sync refresh mistook the local device's old snapshot for a remote conflict, repeatedly generating conflict copies. The installation package uses a higher Android versionCode, so it can directly overwrite the 0.9.x beta.

| | |
|---|---|
| 💾 **Single-library local-first** | No login or registration required. On startup it opens the local `woo.db` directly. Formal documents are written to SQLite, drafts stay local, and you can browse and edit even when offline |
| 🔗 **WebDAV sync space** | Any HTTPS WebDAV (Jianguoyun, Nextcloud, Synology, etc.). Each device configures the same account, and afterward only a six-digit pairing code is needed. Body text and images are end-to-end encrypted |
| 🧩 **Chunking for large documents** | Long documents and embedded images are chunked at content-defined boundaries, compressed, and encrypted. Only changed chunks are uploaded, and a single operation does not exceed 32 KiB |
| 🔤 **Font system** | The interface uses the built-in "Noto Sans SC / Woo Sans" (true 400–700 variable weights). For body text you can choose Wen Kai (built-in LXGW WenKai), sans-serif (heiti), serif (songti), or monospace. On mobile, the Aa panel lets you adjust font size |
| 📝 **Desktop editing** | Tiptap WYSIWYG editor with Markdown input and paste, tables, outline, and mind maps |
| 📱 **Mobile editing** | Android hierarchical directory and drafts box; floating format bar and Aa panel; auto-save; supports search, moving to directories, sharing, trash, and version rollback |
| ⏱️ **Version history** | Desktop and Android both record versions automatically, and you can also manually create and restore formal document versions |
| 📤 **Files and export** | On desktop you can read and write Markdown / TXT files, and export documents as Markdown, plain text, or PNG |
| 🔒 **In-app access lock** | You can lock folders or documents. This restricts viewing within the app and is not equivalent to disk encryption |
| 🔌 **MCP service** | Optionally enabled on desktop. Lets external AI such as Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and Pi call Woo directly to maintain notes. Read-only by default; writing requires manually enabling it |
| 🎨 **Minimalist design** | A warm, soft light theme plus an eye-friendly dark theme |

A native screenshot and annotation tool for **Niri**.

For region or full-screen captures, NiriCapture first freezes the desktop, then draws the selection overlay on all outputs, and then shows the annotation toolbar directly on the frozen selection. The freeze backend prefers the optional DMS CLI. Without DMS, it automatically falls back to `grim`. Window captures use **compositor-side, per-window rendering in Niri** rather than cropping from a desktop screenshot, so windows that are fully covered by other windows, as well as windows on non-current workspaces, can be captured in full.
